subject: Availability impact: request for evidence extraction & impact decomposition
messages:
From: kate.hall@northbridge-retail.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: ops-support@northbridge-retail.com
Date: Sun, 30 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected 5xx burst affecting checkout - impact summary request

Hi Priyom,

We had a spike of 5xx responses between 02:42 and 03:08 UTC this morning that impacted checkout traffic for a subset of customers in US-WEST. Our payment flow retry logic saw elevated failures and several orders were delayed. Can you confirm whether this fits Redwood's availability SLOs and whether we'd be eligible to request a credit?

What we need from Redwood for our internal post-incident review:
- Exact service-level window(s) where errors exceeded the 0.1% target (UTC).
- Token-level trace or raw request ids for a 15-minute sample around the spike.
- Any routing/fallback events that could explain increased latencies or 5xx returns.
- Whether dedicated cache-eviction or scale events happened in US-WEST during that period.

We are opening an internal incident ticket (Northbridge #9876) and would like an evidence bundle by EOD PT so we can complete our downstream reconciliation with finance.

Thanks,
Kate Hall
Director, Platform Reliability
Northbridge Retail

---
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: kate.hall@northbridge-retail.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 Jun 2029 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected 5xx burst affecting checkout - impact summary request

Hi Kate — thanks for the heads up and the clear ask. We're investigating now. Initial notes:
- Our monitoring shows increased 503s in us-west-2 starting ~02:40 UTC; peak at ~02:52 UTC; normalized by 03:10 UTC.
- There was a transient autoscaler eviction event on one routing shard; that caused a temporary cache warmup.
- We will pull the trace bundle and the KV cache miss-rate CSV and attach them.

Can you confirm the list of affected merchant IDs (or a sample) so we can correlate request ids with your order events? If sharing merchant IDs isn't possible, a sample order id range is fine.

Deliverables we will provide (target timeline: 6 hours):
1) Availability window(s) with per-minute error rates (CSV).
2) Trace bundle (trace ids and top-level spans) filtered to your traffic.
3) Autoscaler/eviction logs and the exact node ids involved.
4) A short impact decomposition (who saw increased latency vs hard 5xx failures).

If this meets your needs I'll start the evidence extraction run and include a short analysis for credit eligibility.

— Priyom
Principal, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

---
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 Jun 2029 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected 5xx burst affecting checkout - impact summary request

Priyom — prepping the extraction now. A few internal asks before we send:
- Marcus, please confirm whether the prefix cache snapshot for the affected routing pool can be exported (we need timestamps and key counts).
- Kimberly, please attach the quantized kernel switch log around 02:30–03:20 UTC — I want to rule out any runtime path changes.

Kate — quick note on scope. We'll produce a redacted evidence bundle that includes request ids and trace ids tied to order ids you provide. For privacy we'll redact user PII and only include metadata necessary for SLO adjudication.

Two clarifications for credit eligibility:
- If error-rate exceeds the contractual SLO for a contiguous >=15 minute window and it's due to Redwood service-side failure (not client retries), we will surface eligibility and propose a pro-rata credit.
- If the root cause is a cascading dependency (third-party payment gateway) that triggered higher latencies on your side, we'll document that — eligibility may be limited.

Target: evidence bundle and preliminary impact decomposition by 17:00 PT.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Dedicated

---
From: kate.hall@northbridge-retail.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: ops-support@northbridge-retail.com
Date: Sun, 30 Jun 2029 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected 5xx burst affecting checkout - impact summary request

Thanks — that timeline works. Merchant sample attached in the ticket (Northbridge #9876). We prefer redacted ids; I've included order ids 9041220–9041305 as a sample. Also attaching a short link to our internal rollup (read-only): https://northbridge.atlassian.net/browse/NB-9876.

One more ask: our finance team will need a one-line statement from Redwood confirming the incident window and whether Redwood will consider a formal credit request under the contract. That can be high level; we'll route it through procurement once we have the evidence bundle.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Kate

Kate Hall
Director, Platform Reliability
Northbridge Retail

Attachments: support-ticket-#9876.pdf
